observations: Three photos show a hand holding a motorcycle ignition switch with a key inserted.
The switch has a black cylindrical body with a silver top ring labeled 'IGNITION'.
A grey metal mounting plate with two holes is attached to the base.
Three wires (red, green, blue) emerge from the side, connected to a white plastic connector.
The key is black with a ring and appears to be a standard motorcycle key.
The background is a tiled floor, and the watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI SAINTULOT ENT' is visible on all photos.
No visible damage or wear is apparent on the switch or key.
